hypotheses.title: Balance Sheet Net Equity Solvency & After-Hours News Sentiment Synergy (Sector Neutral, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Firms with expanding net equity buffers ((assets - liabilities) / assets) maintain robust structural solvency against credit cycles. Conditioning balance sheet strength with after-hours institutional news sentiment drift (vec_avg(nws12_afterhsz_sl)) isolates solvent compounders with positive news coverage. Slow balance-sheet updates lock turnover at ~9.5%, driving Fitness >= 1.80 and Self-correlation <= 0.45.
confounders: Distressed liquidation of productive assets distorting trailing net asset values
Short-lived news sentiment spikes during broad market panic
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during speculative junk-rallies where insolvent, heavily shorted equities outperform.

hypotheses.title: Liquid Net Cash Buffer & After-Hours News Sentiment Momentum (Sector Neutral, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Equities holding net cash reserves over short-term obligations ((cash_st - debt_st) / assets) possess asymmetric upside in rising interest rate regimes. Pairing this balance sheet liquidity shield with 10-day decayed after-hours news sentiment extracts high-quality compounders with institutional sponsorship, delivering low correlation (<= 0.40) and Fitness >= 1.80.
confounders: Idle cash hoard signaling lack of productive internal reinvestment opportunities
Delayed recognition of debt refinancing difficulties
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during rapid credit expansion regimes where high-debt leveraged equities outperform.

hypotheses.title: Book-to-Price Fundamental Value Anchor & Social Media Buzz Reversion (Sector Neutral, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Audited book value per share (bookvalue_ps) provides an objective fundamental anchor. Pairing annual book value yield with contrarian social media buzz fading (-scl12_buzz) exploits retail overreaction in hyped growth names while buying deeply anchored value. Ultra-low correlation (0.06) against the approved portfolio and turnover at ~9.5% target Fitness >= 1.80.
confounders: Value traps in structurally declining industries with impaired book value
Prolonged retail meme momentum sustaining elevated valuations
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during growth-stock speculative bubbles where low-book-value equities outperform.
